subject: DPA redlines, SCCs mapping and evidence run - next steps
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redlines + SCCs mapping request

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Attached is AcmeHealth's redline of the proposed DPA (Acme_DPA_redline_v1.docx). A few asks from our side so we can get legal/infosec signoff this week:

- Can you confirm which Standard Contractual Clauses variant you're proposing (EU SCCs 2021 / EEA addenda) and provide a short mapping matrix back to the DPA clauses?
- We need a consolidated subprocessor list and whether any subprocessors will process data outside the EEA/UK — please flag countries and controls.
- Please provide SOC2 Type II evidence (or an interim attestation) and recent penetration test summary.
- If Redwood expects to rely on an MSA redline you already agreed with other health customers, include that as well so we can align the Order Form.

Goal: legal & procurement would like to see the SCC mapping + evidence by EOD Wed (PST). If that timeline is tight, tell us what you can deliver and by when.

Attaching: Acme_DPA_redline_v1.docx

--
Emma Chen
Senior Counsel, Data Privacy
AcmeHealth
emma.chen@acmehealth.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs mapping request

Thanks Emma — received and we’ll prioritize. High level: we plan to propose the EU 2021 SCCs with our standard EU addendum and a short Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) that calls out hosting regions + subprocessors.

Quick commitments:
- We’ll return an SCC-to-DPA clause matrix and the redline reconciliation by EOD Wednesday (11/13 PST).
- Laura will collate SOC2 evidence and the pen test summary.
- Karthik will confirm the subprocessor roster and flag any non-EEA processing.

If anything changes I’ll update you, but that timeline should be feasible.

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.inference.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Action items for Acme DPA redline (timeline = EOD Wed)

Laura / Karthik — looping you both to coordinate the evidence run for Acme. Please see Emma’s asks (below). Action plan:

1) Karthik:
   - Populate the redwood-sccs-matrix.xlsx with the proposed SCC variant (EU 2021) and map to Acme's DPA clause numbers. Use the "Suggested MSA tieouts" column for any order-form alignment notes.
   - Confirm whether any subprocessors process in the US/India/APAC and flag where additional safeguards are in place. If any subprocessor processes in a restricted jurisdiction, note the control (e.g., encryption at rest, contract clause).

2) Laura:
   - Pull the most recent SOC2 Type II report (Q2 2027) and pen test executive summary. Redact PII as needed, but include coverage window and control scope.
   - Prepare a one-page evidence cover note we can hand to Acme procurement (short bullets + link to secure Drive).

3) Me:
   - I’ll draft a short Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) skeleton and return the SCC mapping.
   - I’ll also reconcile Acme_DPA_redline_v1.docx against our standard DPA and call out any customer-specific exceptions.

Timeline: initial deliverables to Emma by 2027-10-13 17:00 PDT (EOD). If either of you need an extension, tell me now.

Thanks — Irene

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Action items for Acme DPA redline (timeline = EOD Wed)

Irene / Laura — quick update on subprocessors and SCCs mapping.

- Subprocessors: attaching subprocessor_list_v2.csv (internal). Most processing for embeddings and inference occurs in our us-east-1 and eu-west-1 pools (no customer data placed in other regions by default). We do have one analytics subprocessor (MetricFlow Inc.) that performs telemetry aggregation in our Singapore cluster for a separate product line; for Acme we can assert no telemetry export to APAC but the vendor still appears in the roster — I'll flag it in the matrix and propose either a contractual restriction or a regional configuration.
- SCCs: confirm we will use EU 2021 SCCs, addendum A mapping is in redwood-sccs-matrix.xlsx (tab: Acme). A couple of clause tie-outs where Acme redlined specific retention windows — I put suggested language in the "Suggested MSA tieouts" column.
- Controls evidence: I can provide a pointer to the SOC2 pdf and pen test summary in secure Drive; Laura can pull the latest files and prepare the cover note.

Irene: I think we should propose the TIA as a 1-page exhibit referencing the three controls: (1) regional hosting; (2) subprocessor restrictions; (3) export controls & legal basis. Draft attached? I'll ack separately.

Karthik

Attachments: subprocessor_list_v2.csv
From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs mapping request

Irene,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the plan — that should work. A few follow-ups:

- If you can include the draft one-page TIA as part of the deliverable, that would be ideal (Acme legal wants to see the exact proposed text rather than a summary).
- Please provide the SOC2 cover note with the secure Drive link (we'll request access).
- On subprocessors: if MetricFlow remains in the roster but we can confirm no customer data leaves us-east-1/eu-west-1 for Acme, that's acceptable; please mark that as an operational guarantee rather than a promise to change the roster.

Procurement: once privacy signs off, we can pull the Order Form together. We may need a short MSA redline to resolve a liability cap tie-out — if Redwood has a precedent health MSA we can start from, please attach.

Thanks — looking forward to the package by EOD.
